pages.title: Recognise Awakening
pages.text: Some ordinary monsters awaken under suitable conditions, gaining names, awareness and interactions. Herobrine's presence affects their chance, while local and family limits apply.$(br2)When you see a name, observe its speech and actions before attacking.

pages.title: Families & Bonds
pages.text: Supported families include zombies, skeletons, creepers, spiders, ender creatures, witches, raiders, slimes, nether fire creatures, guardians, phantoms, piglins, beasts and Wardens.$(br2)They track relationships with players. Attacks worsen hostility; preferred gifts can improve relations and earn returns.

pages.title: Peer Interaction
pages.text: Awakened mobs may greet you, chat, warn of danger and talk with Herobrine or other awakened mobs.$(br2)Peers may cooperate, argue or fight. Friendly speech does not mean every monster will obey you. Keep watching relationships and nearby threats.

pages.title: Awakened Vessel
pages.text: Use an empty vessel on an eligible awakened mob to capture it. Use the filled vessel on a block or in the air to release. The destination needs enough space.
